values.note: 2026: $34 a night for an electric site (waterfront electric sites the same), $46 for full hookups. recreation.gov's rate table schedules $38 and $50 from 2027-04-16. Visitors to the campground pay $5. Federal pass discounts need the pass holder registered on the site and staying every night.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233443/rates (2026 seasons: STANDARD ELECTRIC $34, STANDARD ELECTRIC WATERFRONT $34, FULL HOOKUP $46; future_fees from 2027-04-16: $38 / $50) + per-site price_range in the campsite search (70 sites $34, 134 sites $46), read 2026-10-20

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id%3A233443 (182 sites list 20/30/50 electric; 134 list Water Hookup Y and Sewer Hookup Y, priced as FULL HOOKUP) + amenities Water Hookups, Sewer Hookups, read 2026-10-20

discounts.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233443 (notice: 'Any person utilizing a Federal Pass for a discount on camping fees must present the discount pass upon request, be registered on the campsite, and occupy the site overnight'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Showers and a playground in each loop; boat ramp in the campground, beach about a mile away; two general stores within three miles. No pets in Loops E and F.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233443 (description; amenities: Accessible Flush Toilets, Showers, Dump Station, Laundry Facilities, Wireless Internet), read 2026-10-20

values.note: recreation.gov's rate seasons split the year: reservations in peak season (2026: May 21 - Sep 6), first-come walk-in seasons before and after it (2026: Apr 17 - May 20 and Sep 7 - Nov 28). 14 days in any 30 at Burnsville Lake. A 2-night weekend minimum is marked 'soft' (not always enforced), so only the 3-night holiday minimum is recorded. Check-in 6 p.m., check-out 5 p.m.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233443 (facility_rules maxStay 14 per rolling 30 days, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, minWeekendStay 2 'soft'; notices on stay limit and check-in) + /rates (Peak Season vs 'First-come, First-served Season' date ranges), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 204 sites in the recreation.gov catalog (the campground says nearly 200), all back-in, 8 not bookable online; Loops A-F and Hill. Listed lengths run 25 to 98 ft, most 45-64 ft.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id%3A233443 (204 campsites, Driveway Entry Back-In on all), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed 50-amp electric with water and sewer. Changed fees 46 -> 34 base: $46 is the full-hookup rate; electric-only and waterfront electric sites are $34 (2026), full hookups +$12, both rising $4 on 2027-04-16. Added Federal pass discount, showers/flush/dump/laundry/wifi, 14-night max, 3-night holiday minimum (weekend minimum soft, note only), the peak-reservation vs shoulder walk-in seasons in the note, 204 back-in sites. Not stated: campground season, booking window, max rig length (top listings 80-98 ft not believed).
